content.thinking: הדף מציג את מדד ת"א-125 עם הסכום והפקדה חודשית שכבר מולאו, והתוצאה הזולה מראה 86,045 ₪ מול 70,000 שהופקדו, עם מינוס של 1,030 ₪ בתיבה נוספת שנראה לי מדאיג. אבדוק את המינוס לפני שאמשיך.
The screen is full of unfamiliar Hebrew labels and figures, and a fund fee of 0.1% plus red minus signs that worry me. I'll go through the two providers and the fund one at a time next.
The three big banks show the bank-by-bank figures, with Discount taking 8,266 ₪ and Psagot 1,049, so I'm checking whether the banks are overcharging.

content.text: Further down: "מזרחי טפחות 77,294 ... 10,537". Then companies I've never heard of with lots of red. I'll check one more screen and then I'm tired.

content.thinking: The narration is a finished write-up of a fund comparison, not process narration, so I'll describe it briefly. Psagot's cheapest fund works out to about 86,000 ₪, the banks take more, and the site looks untrustworthy, so I'm not deciding anything yet.
